entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included when the network wishes to transmit protocol data to the UE, such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events. It is supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the extended protocol configuration options IE in messages to transmit protocol data to the UE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: The user equipment that receives protocol data via the extended protocol configuration options IE when supported end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: PDN connection
entities.description: The packet data network connection for which extended protocol configuration options must be supported end-to-end by both UE and network.

relations.description: The network includes the extended protocol configuration options IE in messages to transmit protocol data to the UE.
The extended protocol configuration options IE enables transmission of protocol data from network to UE.
The extended protocol configuration options IE is only used when supported end-to-end for the PDN connection by both UE and network.
